_comment: Conflicts mods declare inside their own jar metadata (mods.toml / fabric.mod.json) that Modrinth and CurseForge don't list. The planner can't read jars without downloading them, so known cases live here. Match by Modrinth id, CurseForge id or slug. Add entries freely; each needs a source.

conflicts.source: Sodium's and Embeddium's own metadata (both replace the renderer)
Iris's own metadata (needs Sodium itself, not a fork)
Reese's Sodium Options' own metadata (both replace Sodium's options screen)
